name: @fireback/wasm-server
description: Runs a fireback backend compiled to wasm (cmd/fireback-wasm) inside the browser tab, backed by an in-browser Postgres (pglite), and bridges it to a FetchxContext so the rest of the app talks to it exactly like a real network API. Not generated - hand-written, kept separate from @fireback/js-remote-ctx (which `make defs` regenerates) on purpose.
